Model Description

Welcome to our world of nostalgic cartoons, reimagined as detailed STL files for 3D printing.

This Four Arms statue from Toon Studios is made for collectors, painters and cartoon fans who want a standout display piece. You get the complete package in one purchase: the full STL files at 1/6 scale, a pre-supported version ready for your slicer, and a matching poster PDF.

STATUE SIZE

  • 1/6 scale: 30 cm (default)
  • 1/4 scale: print at 150% for 45 cm
  • 1/8 scale: print at 75% for 22.5 cm

Includes: STL files (1/6 scale), pre-supported STL files, and poster PDF.
